name: retro-grid
title: Retro Grid
description: A perspective grid that scrolls toward the viewer. Pure CSS 3D, no canvas. Decorative and still under reduced motion.

props.name: angle
props.description: Tilt of the floor in degrees. 0 is flat on the screen, 90 is edge-on.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Size of one grid cell in pixels.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Color of the grid lines. Any CSS color.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the grid to travel the length of its pattern.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
